sections_target.text: Standard V-A AC voltage measuring instrument, model YOKOGAWA
Two (2) PHU-100 voltage injection test sets
First: Measuring the relay operating voltage setting value on the three phases

rows: Remove the relay cover and withdraw the two relay connection plugs from the voltage transformer secondary terminals.
Insert a Test Plug in place of each of the two relay connection plugs to the voltage transformer secondary terminals, gently, taking care that the Test Plug entry guide matches.
Connect the voltage injection leads from PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to terminals 5, 6 on the Test Plug (R-S position).
Raise the voltage gradually to 110 V (note the movement of the upper disc of the relay, i.e. that the relay has reset).
Reduce the voltage gradually until you observe the start of movement of the upper disc of the relay.
Record the relay operating value (Vop) for the (R-S) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1).
Connect the voltage injection leads from PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to terminals 7, 8 on the Test Plug (S-T position).
Raise the voltage gradually to 110 V (note the movement of the middle disc of the relay, i.e. that the relay has reset).
Reduce the voltage gradually until you observe the start of movement of the middle disc of the relay.
Record the relay operating value (Vop) for the (S-T) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1).
Connect the voltage injection leads from PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to terminals 9, 10 on the Test Plug (T-R position).
Raise the voltage gradually to 110 V (note the movement of the lower disc of the relay, i.e. that the relay has reset).
Reduce the voltage gradually until you observe the start of movement of the lower disc of the relay.
Record the relay operating value (Vop) for the (T-R) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1).
Measuring the relay operating times: Connect the Start leads from the time measuring instrument to terminals T1, T2 on PHU-100 injection test set No. (1).
Second: 18
Connect the Stop leads from the time measuring instrument to terminals 1, 11 on the Test Plug for the (R-S) position.
Set the voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to drop the voltage suddenly to zero volts.
Record the time reading for the complete disappearance of the voltage (voltage value zero %) for the (R-S) position.
Connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) in parallel with PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) on the V-A voltage measuring instrument.
Set the output voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) to 80% of the relay operating value (Vop x (80/100)).
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Switch on PHU-100 voltage injection test set No. (1) and set its output voltage to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
At one simultaneous moment, switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) at 110 V and connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) at voltage (Vop x (80/100)).
Record the time reading for 80% of the relay operating value for the (R-S) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Connect the Stop leads from the time measuring instrument to terminals 2, 12 on the Test Plug for the (S-T) position.
Set the voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to drop the voltage suddenly to zero volts.
Record the time reading for the complete disappearance of the voltage (voltage value zero %) for the (S-T) position.
Connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) in parallel with PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) on the V-A voltage measuring instrument.
Set the output voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) to 80% of the relay operating value (Vop x (80/100)).
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Switch on PHU-100 voltage injection test set No. (1) and set its output voltage to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
At one simultaneous moment, switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) at 110 V and connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) at voltage (Vop x (80/100)).
Record the time reading for 80% of the relay operating value for the (S-T) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Connect the Stop leads from the time measuring instrument to terminals 3, 13 on the Test Plug for the (T-R) position.
Set the voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) to drop the voltage suddenly to zero volts.
Record the time reading for the complete disappearance of the voltage (voltage value zero %) for the (T-R) position.
Connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) in parallel with PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) on the V-A voltage measuring instrument.
Set the output voltage of PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) to 80% of the relay operating value (Vop x (80/100)).
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Switch on PHU-100 voltage injection test set No. (1) and set its output voltage to 110 V.
Reset the time measuring instrument.
At one simultaneous moment, switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (1) at 110 V and connect PHU-100 injection test set No. (2) at voltage (Vop x (80/100)).
Record the time reading for 80% of the relay operating value for the (T-R) position.
Switch off PHU-100 injection test set No. (2).
Reduce the voltage of PHU-100 injection test sets No. (1) and (2) to zero.
Reset all indications on the relay.
Withdraw the upper and lower Test Plugs from the relay.
Refit the two relay connection plugs to the voltage transformer secondary terminals, then refit the relay cover.
